statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS digits (n TINYINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY) ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS seq_100000 (n INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY) ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_details_loaded (org_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, request_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (org_id, request_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_details (ORG_ID CHAR(32) NOT NULL, CONFIG_KEY CHAR(32) NOT NULL, COMPONENT_NAME VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, REQUEST_ID CHAR(32) NOT NULL, UPDATE_DATE INT NOT NULL, UPDATE_TIME INT NOT NULL, CLIENT CHAR(16) NOT NULL, STATUS INT NOT NULL, EVENT_DATA VARCHAR(1024), MESSAGE VARCHAR(512), INSERTED_TIME TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, INDEX STATE_INDEX (UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_TIME, ORG_ID, CONFIG_KEY, COMPONENT_NAME, STATUS, CLIENT)) ENGINE=InnoDB
INSERT IGNORE INTO seq_100000 (n) SELECT a.n + b.n * 10 + c.n * 100 + d.n * 1000 + e.n * 10000 + 1 FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b CROSS JOIN digits c CROSS JOIN digits d CROSS JOIN digits e

INSERT INTO event_details (ORG_ID, CONFIG_KEY, COMPONENT_NAME, REQUEST_ID, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_TIME, CLIENT, STATUS, EVENT_DATA, MESSAGE) SELECT LPAD(HEX(s.n), 32, '0'), LPAD(HEX(s.n * 17), 32, '0'), CASE WHEN s.n <= 10000 THEN 'health' ELSE CONCAT('component_', LPAD(MOD(s.n, 200), 3, '0')) END, LPAD(HEX(s.n * 19), 32, '0'), CASE WHEN s.n <= 10000 THEN 20191001 + MOD(s.n, 14) ELSE 20191101 + MOD(s.n, 14) END, CASE WHEN s.n <= 10000 THEN 80000 + MOD(s.n, 5000) ELSE 200000 + MOD(s.n, 5000) END, CASE WHEN MOD(s.n, 4) = 0 THEN 'data-collector' ELSE 'batch' END, MOD(s.n, 5), CONCAT('event_', s.n), CONCAT('msg_', s.n) FROM seq_100000 s WHERE s.n <= 100000 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_details_loaded l WHERE l.org_id = LPAD(HEX(s.n), 32, '0') AND l.request_id = LPAD(HEX(s.n * 19), 32, '0'))
INSERT IGNORE INTO event_details_loaded (org_id, request_id) SELECT LPAD(HEX(s.n), 32, '0'), LPAD(HEX(s.n * 19), 32, '0') FROM seq_100000 s WHERE s.n <= 100000
